title: Zoning text change for 158-06 Northern Boulevard, Queens
summary: This zoning text amendment would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 158-06 Northern Boulevard in Murray Hill, Queens, alongside a related zoning map change. Together the actions would enable a new 10-story mixed-use building with about 70,765 square feet of space and 76 apartments, 19 of which would be permanently income-restricted. The City Council approved the plan with modifications in 2026.
